info.name: Easy Installer
info.summary: Install custom Nextcloud apps via ZIP or GitHub
info.description:
**Easy App Installer** takes the hassle out of installing custom, beta, or third-party Nextcloud apps.
Normally, installing a custom app requires uploading a ZIP, executing into your web server or Docker pod, unzipping the archive, manually fixing `www-data` file ownership, and enabling the app via OCC.
This app automates the entire process directly from your Nextcloud admin settings.
**Features:** * **One-Click Uploads:** Simply upload your custom app's `.zip` file through the web interface. * **Smart Detection:** Automatically reads the `appinfo/info.xml` inside the ZIP to extract the app into the perfectly named folder, ignoring weird root folder names. * **Auto-Updates:** Safely removes old versions of the app before extracting the new one if the app is already installed. * **Secure by Design:** Because this app handles server-side file extraction, the interface and API endpoints are strictly locked down to Nextcloud Administrators only.
info.author: Job Scholten
